extras: Warning: The plugin modifies content when inserting internal links and may affect document spacing.
intentEvidence: Separates contents in a markdown, assign internal links to each separated content, and generate subsequent linked markdowns.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of breaking down a large Markdown document into smaller, linked, and manageable content pieces.
summary: Cardify separates content within a Markdown file, assigns internal links to each block, and generates corresponding linked Markdown files in a dedicated folder.
